roles.farmerDesc: List crops, connect with bulk buyers, and get guaranteed fair prices without middlemen.
roles.buyerDesc: Order 100% organic, freshly harvested produce directly from local farms at wholesale rates.

payment.title: Payment
payment.directUpiDesc: Pay directly to the farmer's bank account via GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, or BHIM.
payment.scanQrCode: Or Scan QR Code with any UPI App
payment.directPaymentNotice: Payment is sent directly to the farmer. Keep your payment screenshot until the seller confirms.
payment.enterUtrPrompt: Enter 12-digit UTR / transaction ID after paying:
payment.waitingSellerDesc: Your UTR has been submitted. The farmer will verify the payment in their bank account and confirm your order shortly.
payment.invalidUpiId: Please enter a valid UPI ID (e.g., farmer@oksbi)
payment.rejectionReasonPlaceholder: Enter reason for rejection (e.g. UTR not received)
